03 | Food Safety Framework & HACCP

Alur Proses & Pengendalian Bahaya

Pendekatan preventif: setiap tahap proses memiliki potensi bahaya, titik pengendalian, dan bukti monitoring.

TAHAP 01 RECEIVING
TAHAP 02 STORAGE
TAHAP 03 PREPARATION
TAHAP 04 PROCESSING
TAHAP 05 SERVING

Biological Hazards

Pathogenic microorganisms, contamination from raw materials, poor hygiene, improper temperature control.

Chemical Hazards

Cleaning chemical residues, allergens, excessive additives, chemical contamination.

Physical Hazards

Foreign objects such as metal, glass, plastic, bone, stones, or damaged packaging.

Preventive Controls

Approved suppliers, inspection, hygiene, sanitation, segregation, temperature control, process monitoring.

7 Prinsip HACCP dalam Praktik

Langkah Elemen Deskripsi Praktis
1 Hazard Identification Identify biological, chemical, and physical hazards.
2 CCP (Critical Control Point) Determine steps where control is essential to prevent or reduce a hazard.
3 Critical Limit Set measurable limits that distinguish acceptable from unacceptable conditions.
4 Monitoring Define what is checked, how, when, and by whom.
5 Corrective Action Define immediate action when a critical limit is not met.
6 Verification Confirm the system works as intended.
7 Record Keeping Maintain evidence of monitoring, deviations, and follow-up.
